worksSeed.title: Smart Mining Management System
worksSeed.problem: Seven spreadsheets, a phone tree and radio stood between a sensor reading and a decision. I led the UX from nothing — no design system, no patterns, no prior research.
worksSeed.outcome: 147 field observations became an alert flow ordered the way supervisors actually think: Where → Who, then severity. Cognitive load per shift down 58%.

worksSeed.title: Falcon View
worksSeed.problem: Four hospitals ran energy, water, compliance and maintenance on spreadsheets, vendor portals and radio. Nothing arrived in time to act on.
worksSeed.outcome: One role-aware platform replaced seven systems — eight modules on a shared data model, four different front doors, and a morning decision instead of an afternoon audit.

worksSeed.title: Incident Management System
worksSeed.problem: On-call teams were losing their most expensive minutes — the first five — hopping between five disconnected tools just to start responding.
worksSeed.outcome: An On-Call assistant that collapses report, alert and war room into a single Teams conversation: three ways in, one incident object, one place to see everything.

worksSeed.title: From the Notebook
worksSeed.problem: How do you redesign a billing portal that 340,000 businesses can't escape — when the portal isn't the thing that's broken?
worksSeed.outcome: The scribbles, sticky walls and 2am margin notes: 120,000 reviews coded, 23 diagrams, 30+ concepts, 25 killed — and the evidence trail left in full view for the sceptical reader.
